objective: Course-correct the Oyatie prototype after user feedback that the mockup had regressed away from the supplied Bominal visual, feature, and functional reference. This slice restores Bominal-grade topfold density, removes visible framework-demo chrome, fixes workflow/employee spatial regressions, and makes header Activity/Settings controls fully local-interactive.
user_feedback_addressed: The previous mockup was not close enough to /Users/jasonlee/Downloads/Bominal in visual quality.
Feature and functionality depth needed to feel like one cohesive product rather than disconnected mock cards.
Header notification/settings icons were present but previously shallow/inert.
Workflow Studio and Employees surfaces needed to read closer to Bominal's dense product surfaces and avoid clipped or cramped content.
implemented: Removed visible SSR/selective-WASM demo badges from the header while keeping the metadata in SSR HTML for traceability/tests, making the app bar visually match Bominal's clean command bar.
Changed the hero copy back toward the Bominal command-center wording: Operations · 2026 May, week 19; This week — close, filings, people, approvals.
Added a Bominal-like Priority queue count and kept the topfold as metrics + priority queue + governed copilot rather than exposing the generic context-switcher island at the top.

Added fully local Activity Center and Workspace Settings drawers wired from the header and command palette, with filtering, mark-read, density switching, settings tabs, identity handoff, and activity events pushed from local product actions.

Tightened Workflow Studio geometry: node column spacing now fits the visible board, the IDE gets more vertical room, node toolbar scrolls horizontally, and the fourth node column no longer clips in the 1440px smoke state.
Made the integrated Employees settings page closer to Bominal by hiding the tertiary provenance rail in the identity suite and widening the employee table/search/stats surface.
Kept Messenger/Mail/Community as one cohesive local Work Hub with command-palette switching, tabs, route buttons, search, local drafts, evidence attachment status, and no external send.

observations: SSR output includes Operations · 2026 May, week 19
SSR output includes Priority queue count and Activity/Settings drawer markup

visual_verdict.category_match: Bominal-style dense enterprise operations shell with integrated workflow, employees, mail/messenger/community, activity, and settings surfaces
visual_verdict.verdict: This rescue slice passes the Visual Ralph threshold for the regression called out by the user. The topfold now visually tracks the Bominal corporate reference; Workflow Studio and Employees are closer to the Bominal product density; header utility controls are visually and locally functional. This is still an Oyatie cohesive shell, not a literal asset copy.
improved_matches: Clean Bominal command bar without visible framework/demo pills.
Topfold hierarchy matches Bominal: title/lens, compact metrics row, priority queue, governed copilot.
Workflow board shows a dense left palette, grid canvas, node cards, AI suggestion, inspector, node toolbar, and fit/validate/run/publish actions without clipping the fourth node column.
Employees view now has Bominal-like settings rail, stats, search, filters, and wide directory table.
Messenger/Mail/Community and Activity/Settings controls are locally interactive with no console errors or failed network responses.
remaining_differences: Oyatie keeps a global cohesive shell rail around Workflow and Settings surfaces, while Bominal references include some standalone pages without the global command-center rail.
Exact Bominal icons, brand names, data values, and route separation are intentionally adapted rather than copied as-is.
All functionality remains visual/local-only: no backend persistence, external sends, workflow execution, money movement, tax filing, auth mutation, or HR write occurs.

non_claims: No production backend wiring is claimed.
No real auth, notification delivery, email send, community post, workflow execution, HR mutation, tax filing, invoice send, or payment movement occurs.
The complete Oyatie mockup still has room for route-level refinements; this slice specifically repairs the regression and closes the most visible Bominal parity gaps.
